summary: T731 follows CLUB r62: modern growth eligibility uses the existing current-ability/youth-promise term before age discounts, while base age/years, premium<=1, wage math, indices, anchors and canonical consumers are preserved. The extracted promisePoints keeps the old marketPoints operation order. Direct tests cover early output vectors, unchanged full-reach values and wages, old-age base discounts, premium-one continuity and ability/potential monotonicity; the reviewer reran market-prices.test.ts (40/40 passed). The reporting changes separate roster values from actual paid permanent arrivals and zero-fee arrivals, use arithmetic medians, and report purchases, sales and net spending with selected-sample caveats. No blocking issue found. Long-run economic fit and final integration/contract/browser checks remain coordinator-owned; approval is not a claim that the cash-surplus target has passed.
